# Watering houseplants the right way

More houseplants drown than dry out: roots in wet soil cannot breathe and rot.

## The finger test

Push a finger into the soil. Water only when the top two centimeters are dry, then water until it runs out of the bottom.

## Light first

A plant in a dark corner drinks little. Move it to brighter light before you change how often you water it.
